Army Agniveer Admit Card 2026: Your Gateway to a Valiant Future!

The Indian Army Agniveer recruitment drive for 2026 has been a significant opportunity for countless young aspirants aiming to serve the nation. If you've successfully completed your application, the eagerly awaited Agniveer Common Entrance Examination (CEE) Admit Card 2026 is now your crucial pass to the next stage of selection. This comprehensive guide will walk you through everything you need to know about downloading your admit card, important dates, and essential exam day instructions to ensure you're fully prepared.

Key Dates for Agniveer CEE 2026

Staying informed about the critical timelines is paramount. The Indian Army has released specific dates for the recruitment process, from registration to the CEE examination.

Event Date
Online Application Start Date February 13, 2026
Online Application Last Date April 10, 2026 (for most posts)
Admit Card Release Date May 15, 2026
CEE Exam Dates June 1 to June 15/16, 2026

The Agniveer Admit Card 2026 was officially released on May 15, 2026, with the CEE examinations scheduled from June 1 to June 16, 2026.

How to Download Your Army Agniveer Admit Card 2026

The process to download your admit card is straightforward and can be completed online. Follow these steps carefully:

1. Visit the Official Indian Army Website
Navigate to the official recruitment portal of the Indian Army: joinindianarmy.nic.in.
2. Locate the Admit Card Link
On the homepage, look for the "Agniveer CEE Admit Card 2026-27" link or a "Candidate Login" section. This is usually prominently displayed under "Agnipath" or "Latest News".
3. Log In with Your Credentials
Click on the link and you will be redirected to the login page. Enter your Registration Number/Roll Number/Email ID and your Password (or Date of Birth).
4. Complete Captcha Verification
Enter the security captcha code as displayed on the screen and submit.
5. Download and Print
Once logged in, your admit card will appear on the screen. Download the PDF file and take a clear printout. It is advisable to print multiple copies, preferably in color, for your records and exam day.

Crucial Details on Your Admit Card

Your Agniveer Admit Card is more than just an entry pass; it contains vital information about your examination. Ensure all details are accurate:

✅ Your Name and Roll Number

✅ Your Photograph and Signature

✅ Category and Post Applied For

✅ Date, Time, and Shift of the Examination

✅ Exam City and Full Exam Centre Details

✅ Reporting Time at the Centre

✅ Important Exam Instructions and Guidelines

If you find any discrepancy in your admit card, immediately contact the concerned authorities of the Indian Army recruitment cell to get it rectified.

Exam Day Essentials: What to Carry and What Not To!

To avoid any last-minute hassle, be prepared with the necessary documents and items for your CEE examination:

✅ Printed copy of your Army Agniveer Admit Card 2026 (at least two copies)

✅ A valid Government-issued photo ID proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, Driving License, or Voter ID). Ensure the name matches the admit card.

✅ Two to four recent passport-sized color photographs (preferably the same as uploaded in your application).

✅ A blue or black ballpoint pen.

❌ Do NOT carry any electronic gadgets, mobile phones, smartwatches, or study material into the examination hall.

Overview of Agniveer Eligibility and Selection Process

The Agniveer scheme is designed to recruit young and dynamic individuals into the Indian Armed Forces for a four-year tenure. The eligibility criteria generally include an age limit of 17.5 to 21 years for most posts, with some relaxations for specific technical roles up to 22 or 23 years. Educational qualifications vary by post, typically requiring an 8th, 10th, or 12th pass with specified aggregate and subject-wise marks.

The selection process for Agniveers involves two main phases:

Phase 1: Common Entrance Examination (CEE)
This is an online computer-based test assessing candidates' knowledge in subjects like General Knowledge, Mathematics, Science, and Reasoning.
Phase 2: Physical Fitness Test (PFT), Physical Measurement Test (PMT) & Medical Examination
Candidates who qualify the CEE proceed to physical tests (running, pull-ups, etc.), measurement of height, chest, and weight, followed by a detailed medical examination to ensure fitness for service.

With your Agniveer Admit Card in hand and a clear understanding of the exam essentials, you are now one step closer to fulfilling your dream of serving the nation. Remember to prepare diligently, arrive at the exam center well in advance, and maintain calm and confidence. We wish you the very best for your Indian Army Agniveer CEE 2026!
